records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
VP of Quality – Structural Steel & Bridge Fabrication

**Confidential Fabricator**

The cost of poor quality rarely sits in one department.

Production loses hours to repairs.

Project managers spend time chasing answers.

Shipping loses its window.

And the customer remembers who had to explain the delay.

That’s when quality becomes a leadership issue.

A large-scale structural steel and bridge fabricator is hiring a
**VP of Quality**
to set the quality strategy and make it work across engineering, fabrication and project delivery.

You’ll set expectations with department leaders, use data on rework and audit findings to decide where to act first, and build a quality team that can support the business as it grows.

You’ll need the technical credibility to challenge a welding or inspection decision and the judgment to know when a recurring issue calls for investment, a process change or clearer ownership.

**What they’re looking for**

* Senior quality leadership in structural steel, bridge fabrication or comparable heavy welded fabrication
* Experience owning a quality management system and leading quality managers or inspection teams
* Strong knowledge of AWS D1.1, AWS D1.5 and AISC certification requirements
* Evidence of measurable improvements in rework, delivery performance or customer outcomes
* Confidence representing the business with customers, auditors and third-party inspectors

**Why it’s worth a conversation**

* Executive influence over how quality decisions are made across the business
* State-of-the-art facility: 2000+ tonnes a month
* Complex steel and bridge work where those decisions have a real impact on cost and delivery
* Scope to shape the quality team, systems and standards as the business grows

If you’ve changed how a fabrication business manages quality, I’d like to hear what you changed and what improved.

**Apply on LinkedIn or message me directly for a confidential conversation.**

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

records.title: Director of Engineering & Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

**Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* **10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams**
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree
 **Physical Requirements**

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

records.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
records.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.
 
 
The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.
 
 
The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.
 
 
**This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.**
**Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.**
**Benefits**
Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.
 
 
**Benefits Include**

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
* 401(k) match
* Life insurance
* Short-term disability
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Maternity/paternity leave
* Health savings account (HSA)
* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

**Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To**
Process & Technical Engineering
 
 

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
 
 

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering
 
 

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects
 
 

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership
 
 

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

**Company Overview**
Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.
 
 
**EEO**
Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

records.title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.
 
 
L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.
 
 
***Job Title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering***
***Job Code: 47622***
***Job Location: Camden, AR***
***Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week***
**Job Description:**
The Manufacturing Engineering Director in Camden, Arkansas will plan, organize and technically direct the manufacturing engineering activities and staff. Enable Operations to execute all programs in a safe and efficient manner, and ensuring the achievement of quality, cost and delivery schedule objectives. This position reports to the Senior Director Operations and Site Management. Our Camden, AR site is at $600M+ revenue and produces a diverse portfolio of highly engineered products for aerospace and defense applications. The individual will be responsible for implementing a disciplined operating system in line with the enterprise while improving the operating effectiveness of the site and leading an organization of over 190 people.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**

* 50% - Direct and lead technical team: Analyze, evaluate and determine appropriate solutions for manufacturing technical problems encountered in the application of manufacturing methods, facilities and processes. Apply engineering procedures, provide technical direction, create and apply work instructions and tooling for the factory floor. Participate in program and site corrective action boards and be a key member in customer escape and non-conformance investigations; develop direct cause, root cause and mistake proof corrective actions, as well as separation criteria when required. Ensure proper deployment of resources to achieve cost effective results in support of site and business unit deliverables. Direct the installation of Electronic Work Instructions (Platform is DELMIA) across the site and all product lines. Strict oversight of the Job Safety Analysis and Process Safety Management programs at the site.
* 15% - Administrative management: Ensure a safe work environment and remain in compliance to federal and local regulations. Develop long range technical and administrative plans, goals and strategies.
* 15% - Customer interface: Establish priorities to meet the needs of the customer and the organization with a dedication to support the manufacturing shop floor. Represent the organization as a prime internal and customer contact on manufacturing technical operations.
* 20% - Strategy and Continuous Improvement: Lead the sites Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) program. Drive operational

excellence throughout the organization and create a metrics driven, highly accountable mindset within the organization.
 
 

* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 15 years prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years prior relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of prior relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated supervisory and leadership skills, including planning, organizing and directing activities; developing talent; and collaborating across business units and functional teams to achieve site objectives.
* Strong understanding of business development, program management, engineering, finance, operations and process control, with the ability to engage effectively with plant-floor teams, customers and executives.
* Experience in aerospace and/or general industrial sectors, including multiple years in a leadership capacity, with program management, engineering leadership and experience with inert, energetic and propellant materials.
* High-energy, results-driven leader with a disciplined work ethic, a bias for action and a continuous improvement mindset. Able to drive commitments to closure, elevate performance and lead organizational change in a demanding environment with lean staffing.
* Ability to satisfy federal government requirements for access to government information.

L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. L3Harris is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, characteristic or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local laws. L3Harris maintains a drug-free workplace and performs pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where permitted by law.
 
 
Please be aware many of our positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. records.description:
White Bear Lake, MN
 
 
**About Heraeus**
Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.
 
 
**About Heraeus Medevio**
Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.
 
 
To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
**What You’ll Do Every Day**

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
**Curious? Apply now!**
Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.
 
 
We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov
 
 
**Any further questions?**
If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

records.title: Director, Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
We are looking for someone to join our growing team to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, CNC manufacturing turn-key machine tool solutions. This role combines technical leadership, project management, customer engagement, and team development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for taking large, turnkey manufacturing projects from initial customer requirements through engineering development, testing, implementation, and final acceptance. You will lead projects involving a wide range of CNC technologies. You will coordinate internal engineering resources, customers, machine-tool and tooling vendors, partners, and other suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and to the required technical and quality standards. The Director of Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations will be responsible for establishing project priorities, managing expectations, identifying risks, resolving technical and organizational issues, and ensuring successful project outcomes. While this is a leadership and project-management position, a strong understanding of CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing processes, machine tools, and controls is required. The successful candidate should be comfortable engaging deeply with technical teams and making informed decisions on complex manufacturing challenges when required.

**About Empire Dynamics Machinery, LLC**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 10-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers that collectively wants to see change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director will be accountable for ensuring these responsibilities are fulfilled, whether through direct involvement, delegation to existing team members, or the development of additional team capabilities as the business grows. The role requires both hands-on leadership and the ability to build scalable processes, teams, and organizational capabilities.

**Project Management**

* Lead complex, multi-disciplinary CNC manufacturing projects from project initiation through customer acceptance.
* Establish project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, milestones, and priorities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, resource requirements, budgets, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate engineering resources across multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and constraints, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish project priorities and ensure engineering activities remain aligned with customer and business objectives.
* Lead regular project status meetings and communicate project health to customers and internal leadership.
* Manage project changes, scope adjustments, technical issues, and customer requests.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet defined technical and customer requirements.
* Develop project documentation, status reports, action plans, and lesson-learned documentation.
* Establish and improve project management processes, standards, and best practices across the organization.

**CNC Process Engineering Leadership**

* Provide technical direction for the development of comprehensive CNC manufacturing processes.
* Oversee development of CAM programming, tooling strategies, fixturing, workholding, process parameters, and setup documentation.
* Review and approve process plans and CAM development strategies.
* Guide engineers in analyzing critical machining operations for feasibility, efficiency, and optimization.
* Oversee development of stage models, setup sheets, work instructions, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Coordinate tooling suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Support development of process outlines to distribute engineering work effectively across the team.
* Provide technical leadership during machine setup, program verification, and customer program runoff.
* Maintain awareness of current CNC machining technologies and manufacturing practices.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop CNC manufacturing engineers and technical staff.
* Assign project responsibilities based on team capabilities, project requirements, and priorities.
* Establish clear expectations for technical quality, project execution, documentation, and communication.
* Provide technical and professional mentorship to developing engineers.
* Identify training and development opportunities for team members.
* Encourage knowledge sharing and standardization across projects.
* Help establish career-development paths and technical competency expectations for the engineering team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Oversee the development of relationships with tooling manufacturers, machine-tool builders, software providers, and other technical partners.
* Manage vendor activities associated with project tooling, fixturing, machine capabilities, and software requirements.
* Establish technical requirements and deliverables for external suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance against project schedules and requirements.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical or project-related vendor issues.

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE**

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical knowledge to effectively lead highly specialized CNC engineering projects. Experience with the following is highly desirable:

* NX CAM and CNC programming
* CAM programming and toolpath development
* CNC machine tools, including milling, turning, mill-turn, HMC, VTC, grinding, and specialty machines
* CNC machine controls, macros, probing, and advanced machine functions
* CAD modeling
* Cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and machining strategies
* Fixture design and workholding
* Manufacturing process development
* CNC machine commissioning and runoff
* NX CAM templates and productivity environments
* Teamcenter, MRL, and machining data libraries
* Software development or scripting
* Manufacturing engineering and machine-shop operations

The Director is not expected to personally perform every technical task. Rather, the position requires the ability to understand complex technical issues, establish direction, evaluate solutions, allocate resources, and ensure the engineering team delivers the appropriate solution.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, mathematics, manufacturing, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience in CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Strong project planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
* Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

**Preferred**

Experience with:

* Managing complex, customer-facing manufacturing projects.
* Using NX CAM and Siemens manufacturing software.
* Post-processors and CNC controls.
* Leading engineering or technical teams.
* Software development or technical product development.
* Working directly with machine-tool builders, tooling manufacturers, or manufacturing suppliers.
* Developing manufacturing processes for multiple CNC machine types.
* Project management methodologies, scheduling, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Customer acceptance testing and technical implementation projects.

Knowledge of:

* Variety of CNC controllers and willing to learn new controller types
* CNC programming techniques and process
* Feeds, speeds, and cutting tool applications
* Geometry and trigonometry
* Fixture specifications, design, and work holding.

A strong sense of curiosity and problem-solving skills

Demonstrated proficiency interpreting drawing and specification requirements

**Leadership Characteristics**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Ownership: Takes responsibility for project outcomes from initiation through completion.
* Leadership: Provides clear direction while empowering technical experts to perform their best work.
* Customer focus: Understands customer objectives and translates them into practical engineering solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Enjoys learning new technologies, machines, software, and manufacturing processes.
* Communication: Clearly communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and expectations.
* Organization: Can manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams.
* Problem solving: Approaches difficult technical and organizational challenges systematically.
* Continuous improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve both customer solutions and internal processes.
* Accountability: Establishes measurable expectations and follows through on commitments.

**Location**

Albany, New York or Remote.

**Travel Requirements**

20% travel to customer sites, partners, or other business-related travel.

**About Empire Dynamics**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 13-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers with a collective goal to pursue change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**BENEFITS**

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Retirement
* Disability Insurance
* Generous Paid LeaveThe Role

records.title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
records.description:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
 
 
The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Customers, and Platform Engineering to achieve successful product launches.
* Align manufacturing capabilities with customer requirements and growth plans.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
* Lead cost reduction, productivity, yield improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.
* Build a culture of accountability, standardization, and continuous improvement.

**Ownership & Interfaces**
**This Role Owns**

* Manufacturing Engineering
* Process Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Test Engineering
* Test Automation
* Manufacturing readiness
* Factory readiness
* SOPs and engineering standards
* FPY, RTPY, DPPM, productivity, throughput, and operational KPIs
* Manufacturing validation and production ramp execution
* Customer TPM organization

**Partner Organizations**
**Platform Engineering**

* Product architecture and design
* Product specifications and BOM ownership
* DFM/DFA approval
* Product validation and qualification
* Design changes and reliability engineering
* Level 3 debugging, root cause analysis, and technical solution development

**Customers**

* Product requirements
* Acceptance criteria
* Product roadmap priorities
* Qualification and approval requirements

**Key Metrics**

* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
* DPPM
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Productivity and labor efficiency
* Manufacturing cycle time
* Automation ROI
* NPI launch success
* Customer satisfaction
* Global standards adoption

**Qualifications**

* BS in Engineering required; MS/MBA preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
* Proven success in high-volume electronics, server, rack integration, or data center manufacturing environments.
* Strong customer-facing leadership skills.
* Demonstrated track record improving FPY, RTPY, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
* Lean Six Sigma and global manufacturing experience preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**
A strategic and hands-on engineering leader capable of building a world-class global manufacturing engineering organization that delivers scalable NPI execution, advanced automation, operational excellence, and industry-leading quality for hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure products.
 
 
**About ZT Systems**
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining.
 
 
A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.
 
 
Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.
 
 
**What We Offer**
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.
 
 
**Compensation & Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based annual bonus eligibility
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health & Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs-
 
 

* Company-paid life and disability insurance

**Time Away & Work-Life Balance**

* Paid time off (PTO) and company-paid holidays
* Parental leave and family care support programs

**Growth & Purpose**

* Structured training programs and on-the-job learning opportunities
* Matching gifts and volunteer programs to support causes you care about

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location. Learn more about our benefits here.

records.title: Sr. Manager Manufacturing Engineer
records.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards
 
 
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
DESCRIPTION:
 
 
As a Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide and support engineering teams to drive operational excellence and innovation across our manufacturing facilities. You will provide strategic direction and technical leadership for manufacturing processes, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement projects while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, you'll optimize production efficiency, implement new technologies, and deliver solutions that enable our mission of making the world healthier, cleaner and safer.
 
 
REQUIREMENTS:
 
 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in regulated manufacturing environments (pharmaceutical, medical device, or related industries)
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Chemical) or related technical field. Strong focus on Automation required.
* Industry certifications in Six Sigma, PMP, or related areas are beneficial
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams and facilitating organizational change
* Demonstrated success implementing automation, digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of cGMP, ISO standards and regulatory compliance requirements
* Experience with new product introductions, technology transfers and process validation
* Expertise in lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodology and practical process improvements (PPI)
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans aligned with business objectives
* Strong project management skills and experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with data-driven decision making
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders at all levels
* Proficiency with manufacturing systems, automation platforms and quality tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Experience with capital project planning, budgeting and resource allocation
* Relocation: Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.
* Pre-Employment Screening: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements, including a background check and drug screening, in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

**Compensation And Benefits**
The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $155,100.00–$232,650.00.
 
 
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:
 
 

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

records.title: Senior Manager, Asia Manufacturing Strategy & Operations
records.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Global Innovation, oversees performance management, operational excellence, and strategic execution for manufacturing entities across Asia, including Vietnam, China, and South Korea. Serves as a key liaison between headquarters and regional production sites, driving data‑driven decision‑making, productivity improvements, and process standardization.
 
 
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Management & Financial Oversight
* Monitor and evaluate the operational and financial performance of manufacturing subsidiaries in Asia
* Develop and manage KPIs
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with regional leadership
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans
* Strategic Planning & Execution
* Formulate mid- to long-term manufacturing and supply chain strategies aligned with global business objectives
* Support capacity planning, cost optimization, and footprint strategy (e.g., China+1, nearshoring)
* Conduct market and operational feasibility analysis for new investments or expansions
* Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across production sites (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen)
* Standardize processes and implement best practices across regions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Procurement, Logistics, Quality, R&D) to improve end-to-end efficiency
* HQ–Regional Coordination
* Act as the primary liaison between HQ and Asia manufacturing teams
* Ensure alignment on corporate policies, reporting standards, and operational priorities
* Facilitate communication, issue resolution, and project execution across time zones
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting systems for real-time performance tracking
* Analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights and executive-level reports
* Support digital transformation initiatives (ERP, MES, data integration)

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred)
* 7–10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or operations strategy roles
* Proven experience managing or overseeing operations in Asia (Vietnam, China, Korea preferred)
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI/Tableau, or similar tools
* Deep understanding of manufacturing KPIs and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Multilingual capability (Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese is a plus)
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to travel internationally (20–40%)

**Benefits**

* Premium Medical Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Savings Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) based on seniority
* Paid Holidays

**Additional Workplace Offerings (subject To Change Or Eligibility.)**

* Annual Bonus Plan
* Onsite Employee Fitness Center with Indoor Racquetball Court and Yoga Room
* Summer Fridays
* Complimentary Gourmet Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
* Relocation Support for New Hires
* Work Anniversary Recognitions
* Congratulatory & Condolence Gifts
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* License/Certification Reimbursements
* Corporate Employee Discounts
* Visa Sponsorships (100% paid by the company) i.e., New H-1B, H-1B Transfer, O-1, and Green Card
* Commuter Support (Shuttle Bus Program and EZPass Support)
* Vehicle Perks

**Qualification(s)**
**Education(s):**
Bachelor of Science (B.S) (Required)
 
 
**Work Experience**
Experience Range V: +13 years of relevant experience or industry exposure in a related field
 
 
**Skill(s)**
Lean Process Improvements, Manufacturing, Operational Strategies, Six Sigma Framework, Supply Chain
 
 
**Language(s)**
English, Korean
 
 
**Certification(s)**
Not Applicable
 
 
The anticipated compensation range is
 
 
91,000.00 - 172,000.00 USD Annual
 
 
Actual compensation will be determined based on various factors including qualifications, education, experience, and location. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

(collectively, the “Company”) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality Engineering - Manufacturing Operations (2nd Shift)
records.description:
The
**Senior Manager, Quality Engineering (2nd Shift)**
is a people leadership and manufacturing quality role responsible for providing quality and compliance oversight across second-shift operations. This leader will manage and develop a team of Quality Engineers while partnering closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to ensure manufacturing activities are performed safely, effectively, and in compliance with applicable quality system requirements.
 
 
The position will oversee quality and compliance activities supporting the plant’s major production areas, including THV manufacturing, TMTT manufacturing, advanced catheters, and metals. The successful candidate will strengthen NCR and CAPA execution, improve investigation quality, monitor operational quality metrics, and establish effective communication and continuity between first- and second-shift teams.
 
 
***This position supports our 2nd-shift operation (Monday - Thursday, 3:30 PM - 2:30 AM).***
**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Quality Engineers supporting second-shift manufacturing operations, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and individual development plans.
* Provide quality and compliance oversight for second-shift manufacturing activities, ensuring operations are performed in accordance with approved procedures, quality system requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Oversee the initiation, investigation, review, approval, and timely closure of nonconformance reports, including evaluating investigation quality, root cause determination, corrective actions, and product or process risk.
* Own and provide leadership for CAPAs, including investigation strategy, root cause analysis, action planning, implementation, effectiveness verification, and sustainable closure.
* Lead the deployment, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management systems and manufacturing quality processes aligned with ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820.
* Review and approve test method validations, measurement system analyses, and manufacturing process validations, including IQ, OQ, and PQ documentation.
* Monitor quality metrics, trends, investigation performance, and quality data reviews; identify emerging risks and provide actionable recommendations to Operations and Quality leadership.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring second-shift operations remain inspection-ready, responding to auditor questions, and leading or supporting actions resulting from audit observations.
* Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to resolve quality issues, maintain compliant production, and strengthen operational controls.
* Establish effective shift-to-shift communication and escalation processes to ensure timely transfer of quality, production, and compliance information.
* Provide quality leadership for supplier-related issues, as applicable, including investigation support, corrective actions, and supplier performance concerns.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and proactive risk management throughout second-shift operations.
* Develop and implement quality processes that improve product compliance, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Other incidental duties as assigned.

**What You'll Need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree with relevant Quality Engineering, Quality Management, or Manufacturing Quality experience within a highly regulated environment; or equivalent experience based on Edwards’ criteria.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience managing and developing engineers or other technical quality professionals.
* Experience deploying, implementing, or sustaining quality management systems within a regulated manufacturing environment, including working knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820 requirements.
* Strong experience leading CAPAs, nonconformance investigations, and structured root cause analysis, including evaluation of investigation quality and effectiveness.
* Ability to work onsite during the designated second-shift schedule, Monday through Thursday, 3:30 PM to 2:30 AM.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred):**

* Engineering or Scientific degree
* Medical device manufacturing experience
* Experience providing quality oversight for manufacturing or production operations, including partnering directly with Operations and Engineering to resolve compliance and product quality issues.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret quality data, monitor operational quality metrics, recognize adverse trends, and escalate significant risks.
* Experience with microbiology principles or microbiological controls in a regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting cleanroom qualification, environmental controls, or manufacturing operations performed within controlled environments.
* Supplier quality or supplier management experience, including supplier investigations and corrective actions.
* Experience reviewing or approving test method validations and measurement system analysis studies.
* Experience reviewing or approving manufacturing process validations, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
* Experience supporting internal, external, or regulatory audits.
* Experience leading quality activities across multiple manufacturing technologies, product lines, or production areas.
* Knowledge of statistical methods, process capability, measurement systems, risk management, and continuous improvement tools.
* Demonstrated success strengthening team capability, improving organizational effectiveness, and leading change within a manufacturing quality organization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate effectively across technical, operational, and leadership audiences.

Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality
records.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
 
 
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
**LOCATION**
: On-site Logan, UT.
 
 

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**
The Senior Manager, Quality for BEA and Flexible Operations at the Logan, Utah site is responsible for leading site quality operations and ensuring compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement across manufacturing processes supporting flexible single-use technologies and products. This role partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and site leadership to drive operational excellence, maintain regulatory compliance, and support business growth.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Quality will lead quality teams responsible for manufacturing quality, quality systems, and customer quality activities while fostering a strong culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
 
 
**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**
**Site Quality Leadership:**

* Lead and develop the site quality organization supporting BEA and Flexible Operations manufacturing activities.
* Establish and maintain a strong quality culture focused on compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a key member of the Logan site leadership team, contributing to strategic and operational decision-making.
* Drive accountability through quality metrics, performance management, and development planning.
* Mentor and coach quality leaders and team members to build organizational capability.

**Quality Systems:**

* Ensure site compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal quality management systems.
* Maintain site inspection readiness, including support for customer, notified body, and regulatory agency audits.
* Oversee effectiveness of Flexible site quality systems including: CAPA, Change control, Nonconformance management, Complaint handling, Document control, Training compliance, Risk management and Validation activities
* Drive timely and effective investigations, root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Support implementation and harmonization of divisional quality initiatives and procedures.

**Operational Quality Support:**

* Partner cross functionally to reduce cost of poor quality and improve operational efficiency.
* Utilize data analytics and quality metrics to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Support product transfers, capacity expansions, and new product introductions
* Ensure robust investigation practices and timely resolution of deviations and customer concerns.
* Build strong customer relationships through responsiveness, transparency, and quality performance.

**HOW YOU WILL GET HERE:**
**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Quality, or related technical discipline required
* Advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of progressive quality experience within regulated manufacturing environments
* 3+ years of leadership experience managing quality teams
* Experience in medical device, bioprocessing, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or single-use manufacturing environments preferred
* Strong knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, GMP, and FDA regulations

**Technical & Leadership Competencies:**

* Strong leadership and team development capabilities
* Proven ability to drive quality improvements in manufacturing environments
* Expertise in root cause analysis, CAPA, risk management, and quality systems
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to influence and build strong partnerships across functions
* Experience supporting audits and regulatory inspections
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Key Success Metrics:**

* Audit outcomes
* Reduction in nonconformance and quality events
* CAPA effectiveness and closure timeliness
* Customer complaint reduction and responsiveness
* Employee engagement and talent development
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction results

**Leadership Expectations:**

* Demonstrate integrity, accountability and customer focus
* Lead through collaboration, communication and empowerment
* Foster a culture of quality, safety and continuous improvement
* Operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed, global organization
* Displays the Thermo Fisher 4i values of Innovation, Integrity, Intensity and Involvement

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel up to 10% as required for business support, training and collaboration across sites

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.
 
 
Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.
