records.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53229
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Sr. Director/ Executive Director of Manufacturing Operations for our new highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and rigor. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Sr. Director/ Executive Director of Manufacturing Operations owns cross-suite production performance across upstream and downstream operations in both single-use and stainless-steel suites. As the site scales to six suites, this leader is accountable for delivery of the site production plan, manufacturing cost performance, and workforce strategy, drives daily operational discipline through MDI and lean standard work, and represents manufacturing on the site Leadership Team.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Own cross-suite production performance and site-wide annual batch plan attainment across all operating suites

* Lead fully integrated, operations-focused suite teams, with upstream, downstream, and support activities managed within each suite, and clear day-to-day accountability for execution, staffing, and scheduling

* Oversee these functions OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary responsible party for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Champion adoption of lean principles across manufacturing including standardized work, visual controls, and a culture of continuous improvement (kaizen) as the site scales to six suites

* Lead the production plan across all suites, working with supply chain to align the supply plan to the production schedule through the site S&OP process

* Drive the site's daily MFG MDI process at the suite level surfacing, escalating, and resolving issues in real time across all shifts

* Serve as the manufacturing process and cost owner, driving cost-per-batch performance and contributing to the site Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and budget

* Manage workforce strategy and ramp for the manufacturing organization, including multi-shift staffing, hiring, training, and qualification of operators as new suites come online

* Ensure cGMP compliance, right-first-time execution, and inspection readiness on the manufacturing floor, partnering closely with Quality on deviations and batch record performance

* Champion a zero-harm EHS culture and drive manufacturing safety performance across all shifts

* Lead manufacturing operational readiness for suites entering service, partnering with Technical Services on tech transfer, process readiness, and PPQ execution

* Build and maintain a lean, scalable manufacturing organization, including area management and round-the-clock shift coverage within each suite

* Partner with quality, technical services, supply chain, environmental health & safety, and operational excellence to resolve issues quickly and operate as one aligned site leadership team

* Establish high standards for performance management and accountability; develop and retain talent; perform other duties as required

* Own a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance
 

 

**This role requires****:**

* B.S in engineering, life sciences, or a related technical field
 + Sr. Director: 15+ years in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including large-molecule drug substance operations including 7+ years of progressive leadership
 + Executive Director: 18+ years in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including large-molecule drug substance operations including 7+ years of progressive leadership
 + Level will be determined based on experience
* Financially literate, with demonstrated experience of delivering production plan attainment, managing cost per batch, and operating within an annual budget

* Experience leading the start-up and ramp of manufacturing suites or facilities

* Experience leading large, multi-shift GMP organizations and building leadership depth

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$207,000.00 - $407,400.00

records.title: Sr. Director, Operations
records.description:
**About Schumacher**

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the $150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers *"celebrate the feeling of home".* F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what's come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our competitive advantage in the industry is our people. We believe that our employees are our most important assets. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company's core values which are as follows:

* Preserve our Start-up spirit

* Take Ownership & Accountability

* Be Solutions-Oriented

* Demonstrate Courage

* Practice Adaptability

* Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role leads our **Paramount Handprints manufacturing operations** — our internal product mills based in Passaic, NJ and the Brooklyn Navy Yard — which are a critical differentiator for the business, providing craft and flexibility across our portfolio.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Sr. Director of Operations** to lead manufacturing operations across our two internal product mills: **one in Passaic, NJ** which produces hand screen-printed fabric and wallcoverings in Passaic, NJ, and another in the Brooklyn Navy Yard which prints digital wallcoverings, both for FS&CO and third-party customers. This individual will oversee the full manufacturing process — from receiving and inventory through order entry, craft printing, quality assurance, shipping and client communications.

This is a builder role. The ideal candidate is scrappy and entrepreneurial, comfortable operating in a hands-on, evolving environment, while also bringing rigor, standards, and consistency to a growing operation. They will balance our commitment to craftsmanship with the need for cost efficiency and anticipate that capabilities and capacity will continue to evolve over time.

This role is based full-time, on-site in Passaic, NJ, five days a week, with occasional travel to our Brooklyn Navy Yard and SoHo locations as needed. It reports to the **Head of Portfolio Development**.

 

**What You'll Do**

* **Leadership**: Lead a team of approximately 60 across both mills.

* Directly manage the Director of Production Planning, Director of Production, Shipping & Warehouse Leads, and Senior Digital Printers at each site and indirectly oversee their teams.

* Oversee the CX leader responsible for order entry and client communication.

* Build a strong, accountable culture across both sites; recruit, develop, and retain talent at all levels.

* **Manufacturing Operations**: Oversee the end-to-end manufacturing process and P&L ownership across both sites, including:

* Warehouse receiving and inventory management

* Screen engraving, color mixing, and trialing

* Production

* Quality assurance and printing

* Cutting, packing, and shipping

* **Process improvement & margin management**: Bring consistency and standardization reliability to our operations.

* Balance craftsmanship with efficiency to protect and improve margin across the mills' output

* Identify and implement process improvements that increase throughput, quality, and reliability without compromising craft.

* Develop and manage spending against budget, in conjunction with Head of Portfolio Development

* Identify cost savings opportunities across from raw materials, vendor contracts and labor

* Develop and track KPIs across capacity, production, quality, fulfillment & financial efficiency

* **Facilities, Safety & Space Planning**

* Own facilities, maintenance, and safety programs across both mills.

* Lead space planning as capacity and capabilities evolve over time.

* Identify opportunities to augment capabilities with equipment & CAPEX investment opportunities

* **Collaboration & Communication**: Serve as an internal partner and external-facing representative of the mills, building trust with cross-functional teams as well as third-party customers and vendors.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and vendors, including third-party manufacturing and supply partners; quickly step into and manage existing external relationships as you transition into the role.

* Partner proactively with Portfolio Development, Design, Procurement, Sales and other cross-functional teams to align capacity and capabilities with business needs.

* Provide proactive, transparent communication and reporting to the Head of Portfolio Development and cross-functional stakeholders

* 8+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations leadership, ideally in a craft, custom, or make-to-order production environment.

* Ability to consistently balance productivity, quality, and craftsmanship at the highest level.

* Excellent people management skills with a demonstrated ability to build culture and develop talent.

* Scrappy, entrepreneurial, and hands-on, balanced with the ability to bring structure and rigor; comfort operating in a business where capabilities and capacity frequently evolve

* Experience with facilities, safety, and space planning oversight.

* On-site, full-time presence in Passaic, NJ required, five days a week, with occasional travel to Brooklyn and SoHo.

* Experience with ERP or production planning software.

* Experience in screenprinting, digital printing, or textile/wallcovering manufacturing or adjacent industries.

records.description:
Job Description
 
 
The Executive Director, Organization & Talent Partner (OTP), Manufacturing Division, reports to the Vice President, Human Resources, Manufacturing Division and serves as the senior strategic organization and talent advisor to senior leaders and their leadership teams within the Global Biologics Operating Unit and the Global Science Engineering and Commercialization organization.
 
 
Operating with a divisional as well as an enterprise mindset, the leader architects the long-term view that connects priorities and business needs into organizational capability planning solutions that help ensure these organizations have the structures, capabilities, leadership, talent pipelines and ways of working needed to deliver their priorities.
 
 
The role operates across complex scientific, pipeline, workforce, geographic and organizational priorities; co-creates strategy; frames organization and workforce choices; and establishes governance and ways of working across multiple leadership interfaces.
 
 
The Executive Director leads a team of two Organization & Talent Partners. Operating with an enterprise mindset, the role connects priorities across Manufacturing, partnering with Talent Enablement and commissioning the right expertise from Centers of Excellence (COEs), Enterprise Team HR (ETHR) and HR Solutions & Operations to bring strategy into execution. As a people leader, the role is accountable for the direction, development, performance and effective deployment of a direct and indirect team of HR professionals.
 
 
**Primary Responsibilities:** 
Shape the agenda
 
 

* Understand, anticipate and translate business strategy into the long-term organization and talent agenda​
* Lead organization capability planning so structures, roles and capabilities are ready for where the business is going​
* Drive strategic workforce planning linked to business direction and transformation
* Bring an enterprise perspective to leadership and business planning, connecting organization, workforce and talent implications across leadership teams and the broader enterprise.

Develop the organization and its leaders
 
 

* Enable talent development strategy, including succession and leadership development for critical populations​
* Coach senior leaders to improve organizational effectiveness, leadership impact and talent decisions​
* Support transformational efforts from an organization and talent perspective​
* Act as steward in organizational effectiveness, driving stronger collaboration across functions and clarity in interfaces, so priorities connect rather than compete

Leverage the HR operating model to bring strategy into execution
 
 

* Be accountable for the strategy and execution of macro-level organizational change and transformation and ensure the right partnerships are activated to deliver successful execution​.
* Engage with TELs, COEs, ETHR, HR Solutions & Operations and other partners to deliver the highest-value business priorities, leveraging expertise and capacity where they reside. Across these partnerships, provide context on business priorities and dynamics, connect organization and talent priorities across divisions and countries
* Seek to understand local nuances and considerations when defining organization and talent strategy and execution plans​

​
 
 
**Experience, capabilities and leadership characteristics:** 
The successful candidate will bring deep strategic HR experience in a large, complex organization and a record of shaping outcomes through influence. The role requires the following capabilities and leadership characteristics:
 
 

* Business savviness: bring the depth of advanced business understanding needed to build differentiated talent strategies and workforce plans leaders will trust​.
* Organization development and effectiveness: diagnose how well the organization is working and take action to close the gaps and strengthen effectiveness, using the OCP playbook and OD team resources​.
* Talent growth and senior-leader coaching: anticipate talent and capability gaps in critical populations well before they become urgent, and shape the succession and development plans that close them​.
* Influence and executive communication: effectively frame and communicate complex or sensitive issues clearly and confidently to stakeholders and partners to ensure effective action is taken, ​and align senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Change catalyst leadership: drive the organizational and cultural shifts your strategy requires, championing new approaches and helping people move through resistance to get there​.
* Networking, partnerships: effectively navigate the organization, delivering through trusted partnerships across the HR Operating Model.
* People leadership: ​Demonstrated success as a people leader, ability to build an inclusive, high-performing OTP team with clear direction and shared accountability.
* Systems Thinking: see the organization as a connected system — deep understanding of he interdependencies between businesses, functions and regions, and read data and signals across them to find the patterns that shape the org and talent agenda​.

**Education:** 

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline required

**Required Experience and Skills:** 

* Minimum of twelve (12) years of progressive HR or closely related business experience, including significant strategic HR partnership experience in a complex, global environment.
* Demonstrated experience advising and coaching senior executives and leadership teams.
* Demonstrated broad-reaching experience in strategic workforce planning, organization capability planning, organization design and development, talent and succession.
* Experience supporting a pharmaceutical, life sciences, manufacturing, or other science-based organization.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders, manage high-risk and sensitive matters, and coordinate outcomes across organizational boundaries. Ability to commission work through a networked operating model. Broad global perspective and the ability to lead with cultural sensitivity across a matrixed, global organization
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, business judgment and analytical capability.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including leading, coaching and developing experienced HR professionals and building a high-performing, inclusive team.

**Required Skills:** 
Change Management, Executive Coaching, Organizational Capability, Organizational Design, Strategic Human Resources Leadership, Strategic Workforce Planning, Succession Planning
 
 
**Preferred Skills:** 
Commercialization, Manufacturing

records.description:
**Job Description:**

**Plant Director**

 

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As a **Plant Director**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Leading a team of employees dedicated to making what is indispensable to empower modern life, advance human progress, and deliver a brighter future through 3M Science.
* Overseeing plant environment, health, safety, regulatory and security practices that respect our environment, meet requirements established by regulatory bodies, protect our employees, and align with company expectations.
* Leading operational excellence through conscientious management and decisive actions in environment, health, safety, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, cost, and employee relations.
* Utilizing operational financial acumen to analyze and understand the financial implications of various choices and actions, making informed decisions based on financial data to maximize profits and minimize losses.
* Understanding and applying technology platform fundamentals and principles, thinking strategically, and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for business growth and operational efficiency.
* Accelerating value creation for our customers through responsive end-to-end supply chain performance and prompt resolution to customer inquiries.
* Developing strategic plans and budgets to drive continuous and sustainable improvements through the application of disruptive technology, lean six sigma methods, and effective employee engagement programs.
* Managing inventory, and influencing supplier performance.
* Championing inclusive programs that create a great place to work for all our employees and demonstrating behavior aligned with a work environment in which employees, consultants, and contract workers know that ethical and legal behavior is always expected of them.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution.
* Ten (10) years of experience in a manufacturing or production facility in private, public, government, or military environment.
* Five (5) years of experience in a plant leadership role.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Proven experience in plant leadership roles, demonstrating the ability to drive operational excellence and achieve results.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality control, and safety standards.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate future trends, effectively prepare for change, create and communicate change action plans, and implement sustainable change.
* Strategic mindset and the ability to develop and execute plans to meet operational goals.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in physical sciences, Operations Management, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
* Experience in proven continuous improvement process improvement methodologies.

**Work location:**

* **Onsite, Tonawanda, New York**

**Travel: May include up to 10%** **domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

**Chat with Max**

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

records.title: Operations Director
records.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

Amphenol's High Speed IO Connectors and OverPass Solutions Business Unit is a market leader in high-speed, high-bandwidth interconnect solutions used in servers, storage, networking equipment, and data center infrastructure. Our products enable reliable, low-loss data transmission in some of the world's most advanced IT and Datacom platforms, helping power the technology behind leading Tier 1 OEMs. With global design, sales, and manufacturing teams, we are growing quickly and continuing to invest in our people and products. This role is a chance to make a real impact as part of a collaborative, fast-moving team within Amphenol's decentralized culture, where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and teams are empowered to make decisions with clear accountability.

**Position: Operations Director**

**Location: USA, Remote**

***Must have multi-site global and electrical manufacturingexperience***

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Leadership**

* Lead new product introductions from concept to full-scale production
* Oversee global plant operations and standardize processes
* Ensure effective resource allocation and EHS best practices
* Manage critical operational issues and crisis response

**Strategy & Capacity**

* Develop and execute 3-year operational and capacity plans
* Lead expansion initiatives, new site development, and capital projects
* Forecast demand and optimize global resource utilization

**Financial Management**

* Oversee global budgets and P&L performance
* Drive cost reduction and operational efficiency
* Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies

**Performance & Reporting**

* Define and monitor KPIs (quality, delivery, productivity)
* Use data insights to improve performance and on-time delivery
* Report results and recommendations to leadership

**Collaboration & Quality**

* Partner cross-functionally to meet customer and business needs
* Ensure compliance with ISO standards and global regulations
* Maintain strong supplier quality systems and audit readiness

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years in manufacturing management (electronics or mechanical preferred)
* Degree in Engineering or related field
* Experience building and scaling manufacturing operations
* Knowledge of ISO 9001/14001, Lean, Six Sigma, 5S
* Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills
* Willingness to travel globally (50%+); Mandarin is an asset

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” - Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol-cs.com/

records.title: Director, Instrument Manufacturing
records.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The primary purpose of this position is to plan and direct departmental functions (Instrument Manufacturing, Engineering, Instrument Refurbishing) at the St. Louis Operations site to ensure achievement of the corporate goals and objectives of the worldwide bioMerieux organization. This position is responsible for the manufacture and maintenance of instrument production and refurbishment through oversight of multiple teams. In addition, this position: provides technical expertise and quality support through implementation of projects and continuous improvement activities; identifies and justifies projects for capital funding, and deliver the projects on time and budget. Also requires coordinating and overseeing the implementation of engineering projects related to cost improvements and new product introductions, ensuring cooperation within and outside the department at both the local and global levels. And finally, responsible for developing and maintaining an engaged, motivated and skilled production work force.

**Primary Duties**
==================

* Manage Manufacturing – Manage the manufacturing and refurbishment groups to ensure customer satisfaction. Deliver the forecasted product on schedule with no errors or nonconformities. Maintain the complex manufacturing process and minimize loss. Maintain high employee morale, drive cooperation between departments at both local and global levels, and drive employee career development.
* Manage and Maintain Production Equipment – Ensure that the manufacturing areas are maintained so that production can continuously manufacture and refurbish product. End result: Successfully manufacturer product to meet demand and improve efficiency to reduce the COGS.
* Product Transfer – Manage the transfer of new products from Research to Manufacturing. Validate the new processes to meet regulatory requirements and ensure the necessary procedures are in place to order parts / materials to meet market demand. End result: Successful market introduction of new, high quality products that meet all relevant and applicable regulatory requirements.
* CAPA Investigations – Manage and provide technical expertise to projects related to investigating failures in current product production or testing processes.
* Cost Improvement and Risk Management – Manage and provide technical expertise to justify and implement cost improvement projects in Operations.
* Finance – Ensure adherence to Departmental budgets.
* Personnel – hiring, maintenance, organization, engagement, and performance of qualified manufacturing, engineering, and other personnel.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree required– Engineering, Supply Chain Management, R&D, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience leading manufacturing operations, with budget oversight and demonstrated experience in cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* 3+ years experience managing operations in an ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformational change.
* Demonstrated experience in talent management and succession planning.
* Experience with capacity, automation, capital investments preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.

records.title: Director Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing
records.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Greenbush
* Req ID:R52954
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.

This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regeneron’s patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, NY
* Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm

**Discover your role:**

* Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
* Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
* Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
* Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
* Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
* Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade A–D) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
* Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
* Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
* Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
* Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
* Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
* Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
* Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
* Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
* Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
* Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits

**This role requires:**

* BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 + Director: 12+ years of experience
 + Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
 + Level will be determined based on experience
* Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
* Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
* Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
* Experience with multiproduct biologics facility start-up is preferred
* Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$175,700.00 - $292,700.00

records.title: Director of Operations - Industrial Manufacturing
records.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

**Position Summary:**

 

Reporting to the site General Manager, the Director of Operations will manage the daily production, inventory, and logistics to ensure save, efficient, cost-effective, and timely delivery to our customers. They are responsible for development and implementation of strategy, growth, and profitability targets for the PSG-Grand Rapids facility. They will have direct ownership for established safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and lean objectives. Additional areas of reasonability include but are not limited to the oversight of: Safety, Plant Management, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Capital Equipment, Facilities Planning, Workforce Development, and Operations Strategy Deployment. A successful individual will deploy and maintain strong operational processes, be data driven, drive continuous improvement, and empower his or her team to solve problems.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Oversee end-to-end supply chain partnerships, warehousing, inventory management, and transportation
* Ensure products meet operations’ profitability goals
* Establish strategic direction, performance metrics, standards, and measurements for direct reports and the operation as a whole that support safety, quality, and delivery expectations
* Sets operational goals and objectives, and guides teams to meet monthly, quarterly and annual targets
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the P&L and continuously execute to achieve revenue and margin commitments
* Provide support and leadership to the supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, and continuous improvement teams by:
 + Supporting sales & operations planning (S&OP) process, and planning manufacturing capacity accordingly to ensure on time and efficient delivery
 + Identifying and responding to trends in the marketplace, anticipating and applying strategies to be ahead of the cost and quality curve
 + Planning and executing a best in class supply chain to ensure appropriate levels of inventory and turns as well as supplier quality and cost
 + Directing the continuous improvement program and supporting on site initiatives as required to ensure adoption of programs and achievement of desired results
 + Ensuring that products are delivered on-time to customers and that products meet all customer expectations regarding quality and performance
 + Planning and implementing capital improvements for the site and operations
* Work proactively with and effectively engaging functional counterparts to ensure overall organizational success and continuity of leadership
* Partner with union leadership to maintain compliance with the collective bargaining agreement while supporting operational goals
* Foster a positive employee relations environment through building a culture where employees are motivated and actively engaged in driving continuous improvement in the business
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and mentors, provides feedback, and takes action as needed to build a high-performing department
Embody the Company’s ethics and values; maintain the highest corporate governance principles 

**Qualifications** :

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, or a related field is required
* MBA/Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other operational leadership role
* Experience in a build to order/high-mix manufacturing environment required
* Proven background in the application of production/inventory control, procurement procedures and techniques, and logistics

Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

The Plant Manager directs overall plant operations and the retail store ensuring the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with the company quality standards and customer delivery requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

1. Prioritize, schedule and delegate work assignments and directly supervise the plant staff to ensure the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with company quality requirements.

2. Monitor suppliers to ensure that they efficiently and effectively provide needed goods or services within budgetary limits.

3. Direct or coordinate financial or budget activities to fund operations, maximize investments, or increase efficiency.

4. Evaluate, recommend, and implement improvements in methods and processes to increase productivity and quality.

5. Develop plans for the maximum utilization of materials, machines and employees.

6. Review production costs and product quality; modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of division.

7. Ensure proper maintenance of equipment and building and establish plant housekeeping standards.

8. Develop and recommend plant capital and operating budgets to ensure conformance to budgets.

9. Develop policies and procedures to ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental and various regulatory agencies.

10. Enforce safety and work rules and company housekeeping standards.

11. Recommend locations for new facilities or oversee the remodeling or renovating of current facilities.

12. Ensure compliance with all quality, SQF, HACCP, safety, and sanitation regulations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage supervisors who supervise employees in the manufacturing of company products. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

 **Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Requires a bachelor's degree in production and operations management from a four-year college or university plus a minimum of five years progressively responsible related experience; or ten years progressively responsible related experience; or a combination of education and experience. Requires the ability to operate a computer and

standard office machines. Requires a general knowledge of company products and procedures. Requires a working knowledge of accounting methods and cost control procedures.

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret blueprints, customer specifications, general business periodicals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as algebraic formulas, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Wear required safety equipment when on shop floor. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects, tools, or controls. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

 **Additional Information**

*The hiring range for this role is $135,000 - $145,000 yearly**. Actual wages will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**: 
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:** 
Jack Link’s provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

**E-VERIFY:** 
Jack Link’s is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For information about the E-Verify program, please visit: http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

records.description:
Overview:

**Hospital Name:** Kessler Institute for Rehabilitation 
**Position:** Director of Plant Operations 
**Location:** Jersey City, NJ

**Compensation**: $90,000 to $145,000 *(Based on years of experience)*

Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas.

**We support your career growth and personal well-being:**

* **Start Strong:** Extensive and thorough orientation program to ensure a smooth transition into our setting
* **Your Health Matters**: Comprehensive medical/RX, health, vision, and dental plan offerings
* **Recharge & Refresh:** Generous PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance
* **Invest in Your Future:** Company-matching 401(k) retirement plan, as well as life and disability protection
* **Your Impact Matters:** Join a team of over 44,000 nationwide committed to providing exceptional care

Responsibilities:

The DPO is a member of the hospital leadership team who works in collaboration with the chief executive officer (CEO) to support the overall operation of the facility, inclusive of administrative and technical operation. Serving as the hospital’s safety officer, the DPO manages the environmental services and security departments to ensure safe operating conditions in compliance with all state, federal and accrediting agencies.

In this role, you are responsible for overseeing all aspects of the maintenance of the facility and grounds, the provision of utilities, the restoration and renovation of the facility and new construction.

* Planning, directing, and supervising all administrative and technical aspects of the department.
* Developing, reviewing, and managing the activities of self and other personnel in the department.
* Actively participating in all hospital committees which impact this department, with specific responsibility on the Safety and Infection Control Committees.
* Establishing and maintaining a Quality Control Program.
* Responsible for maintaining and Environment of Care and OSHA standards in accordance current Federal, State and local standards, guidelines and regulations.

 
Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements:

* Minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience in provision of maintenance, environmental services, and related services in a hospital environment required.
* Knowledge of JCAHO/OSHA regulations and standards required.

Preferred qualifications that will make you successful:

* College Degree related to building construction and maintenance preferred.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Position Description:**

* The Plant Manager is responsible for assisting the Director of Plant Services in engineering, custodial, and minor maintenance at selected facilities as assigned by the Director of Plant Services by starting, stopping, and observing all equipment that is interconnected with the air conditioning and/or heating system, safety, security, cleanliness, and the entire appearance at various facilities.
* The position can require extend or on call work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety or operational routine.

**Scope of Responsibility:**

* Opens building in morning; secures building in afternoon.
* Operates heating and air conditioning systems.
* Sees that rooms are properly ventilated.
* Replaces light globes or fluorescent tubes.
* Receives supplies, checks inventory requesting janitorial supplies; supplies custodial staff. Do not supply to cafeteria or stadium.
* Reports vandalism immediately to principal and keeps reports.
* Checks firefighting equipment and playground equipment for good functioning and safety.
* Repairs, removes or secures any unsafe equipment, reports same to principal.
* Cuts and maintains school yard and shrubs, watering regularly.
* Removes trash and debris from premises.
* Buffs floor when appropriate.
* Maintains cleanliness of halls and entrances during the day.
* Cleans classroom units as specified in accordance with work schedule and specified school needs.
* Is available for school and school sponsored activities. Outside agencies will pay for use of building as prescribed in policy manual.
* Sets up for assemblies, conferences, plays, programs when required.
* Supervises custodial staff, inspects their work, assigns duties, keeps and reports the time for himself/ herself and personnel, etc. in coordination with principal.
* Light maintenance functions, makes minor repairs such as replacing faucet handles, light switches, door knobs and door adjustments, glass repairs, painting, etc. for all buildings on school plant.
* Responsible to carry and answers system issued iPhone before, during and after normal work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety or operational routine.
* Maintains files and operates computer and other machines.
* Performs other duties as assigned by the Director of Plant Services.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* We seek detail-oriented, independent self-starters who demonstrate an unwavering commitment to raising student achievement and who have a record of high performance in challenging situations.
* Successful candidates will also demonstrate and/or possess:
* 3+ years of progressively increasing experience custodial services.
* Strong communication skills in multiple settings and the ability to be an engaging change agent and culture creator that can inspire and motivate.
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to use quantitative and qualitative data to make decisions and recommendations.
* Collaborative management style, with a proven track record of working with diverse individuals at all levels to drive decision-making and results.
* Maintain a valid Louisiana drivers’ license.
* Have knowledge of driving laws, interpreting traffic signals, signs.
* Ability to operate a manual transmission.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED/Hi Set
* Two years of experience in a mechanical trade.
* Two years of college with 48 credit hours earned.

**Physical Involvement:**

* Walking and carrying tools, equipment, building materials, etc. are constant, everyday requirements.
* Surfaces vary including mud conditions after a rain, gravel, concrete, dirt, grass, etc.
* Climbing 6, 8, 10, and 12 foot step ladder, extension ladder, stairs and scaffolding are routinely required.
* This climbing often includes carrying of tools, building materials, etc.
* Trunk flexion and squatting are necessary requirements in accomplishing tasks such as working under raised buildings, in attic spaces, toilet room enclosures, etc., again often necessitating carrying tools, building materials, etc.
* Lifting is required daily in accomplishing tasks.
* Building materials, electrical panels, small generator and pump equipment, desks, full mop buckets, etc., are necessarily moved, in some cases loaded and unloaded from vehicles.
* Fifty pounds is the maximum expected load for one person.
* Two and three person coordinated lifting is occasionally required.

**Compensation:**

* JPS offers a competitive salary that is commensurate with experience.
* JPS also offers a competitive benefits package.

records.description:
Overview:

Are you an experienced **Director of Plant Operations and Environmental Services** seeking a rewarding career that aligns with your lifestyle? Look no further than PAM Health, where we are proud to offer competitive rates and an extensive benefits package designed to suit your needs. *Prefer candidate to live on the East Coast as this role will be supporting Florida- to Massachusetts.*

**What can PAM Health offer you?**

* **Patient-Centric Focus:** Join a hospital dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care and achieving the highest levels of patient satisfaction.
* **Career advancement:** Unlock opportunities for professional growth through our Education Advancement Program
* **Competitive compensation:** Explore our rates and take advantage of a comprehensive benefits package.
 + Medical Benefits: EPO/HDHP/HSA options; including prescription coverage, RX ‘n go, and Teladoc
 + Comprehensive dental and vision
 + Employee Assistance Program, including counseling, legal, and financial services
 + Flexible spending (FSA) and health savings (HAS) accounts
 + Life and Disability insurance benefits
 + Education/In-Service Opportunities including continuing education and tuition services
 + Supplemental benefits: Accident, critical illness, cancer, pet, and identity theft protection insurance options
 + Personal Travel Discounts
 + 401(k) plans and discretionary employer match
 + Generous Paid Benefit Time

Responsibilities:

* Manage Plant Operations, Maintenance, Environmental Services, Safety, and Security activities within established standard and Guidelines, PAM Health Policies and procedures, and budgetary limitations.
* Conduct inspections and maintain the facility and equipment to ensure that all aspects of the environment of Care, Life Safety Code, and interim Life Safety Code are achieved.

Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* Community electrical maintenance license if required.
* Certified Healthcare Facility Manager (CHFM) certification desired.
* Minimum of five years of related experience required.
* Hospital maintenance experience required.
* Must be familiar with JACHO, NFPA, & OSHA regulations.

Its mission is to serve people by providing compassionate, expert care, and to support recovery through education and research. Joining our PAMily allows you to work in a collaborative environment with colleagues and leadership with exposure to a variety of patient care levels. We are excited to learn more about you and hope that you consider joining us on a shared mission to improve the lives of others by being an integral part of our We Care Program. Please take a moment to visit us online at **www.PAMHealth.com** for a comprehensive look at how we're able to positively impact our local communities.

records.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering

postedPay.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering

records.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position operates in both office and manufacturing floor environments and requires a leader who is comfortable engaging directly with engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation.

The expected base salary range for this position is **$220,600 – $314,050 annually**, representing the company's current good-faith estimate of compensation.

Actual compensation will depend on factors including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and specific work location.

This position may also be eligible for:

* Performance-based bonuses
* Equity compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings benefits
* Paid time off
* Wellness resources

TransMedics complies with all applicable U.S. pay transparency laws and does not request or consider salary history.

**About TransMedics**
---------------------

TransMedics is transforming organ transplantation through innovative technologies designed to improve the availability, utilization, and outcomes of donor organs.

Our mission is to help save more lives by advancing the science and technology of organ preservation and transplantation.

Join a growing organization where engineering innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful impact come together to advance life-saving technology.

This is a full-time, **on-site position** currently based at TransMedics' facility in Andover, MA.

TransMedics is preparing to transition operations to a new facility in **Somerville, MA**. Candidates should be aware of this upcoming move and must be willing and able to work on-site at both locations as the transition occurs.

Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the work location or be willing to relocate to the Greater Boston area.

This position requires regular collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams, including direct engagement on the manufacturing floor.

TransMedics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

TransMedics is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process.

We value the unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences of our employees and believe that an inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate and fulfill our mission of saving lives.

**Employee Benefit:**

Medical with Health Reimbursement Account through Blue Cross/Blue Shield of MA

Dental

Vision

Healthcare Flexible Spending Account

Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Short Term Disability

Long Term Disability

401K Plan

Pet insurance

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

TransMedics is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, marital status, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
