thyssenkrupp is an international industrial and technology group with more than 93,000 employees. In the fiscal year 2024/2025, the company generated sales of around €33 billion in 48 countries. Its business activities are bundled in five segments: Automotive Technology, Decarbon Technologies, Materials Services, Steel Europe and Marine Systems. With extensive technological know-how, outstanding engineering competence and a high level of innovative strength, the group develops solutions for the challenges of the future, especially in the fields of climate protection and energy transition, digital transformation in industry and mobility of the future.

To learn more about thyssenkrupp, please visit the following link: thyssenkrupp As An Employer - North America

**Company Presentation**

thyssenkrupp Dynamic Components is one of the world's automotive industry leading partners for development and manufacturing of highly complex, state-of-the-art drivetrain technologies for both combustion engines and electric motors. Worldwide, 10 locations with 3,800 employees produce over 25 million drivetrain components per year. The product portfolio includes camshafts and cylinder head cover modules for the valve train as well as rotor shafts for battery electric vehicles.

Our electrical A/C compressor, designed for the natural refrigerant CO
*2*
, sets new standards in efficient and sustainable thermal management.

With precision and passion, we are enabling our customers in the automotive industry to achieve their emission and sustainability targets for more than 30 years.

thyssenkrupp Presta Dynamic Components is proud to be Certified™ by
**Great Place To Work®**
. The prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at thyssenkrupp Presta Dynamic Components. This year, 82% of employees said it's a great place To Work - 25 points higher than the average U.S. company. Great Place To Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and the leadership behaviors proven to deliver market-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation.

**Your Responsibilities**

**Lead Quality Excellence in a Fast-Paced Manufacturing Environment**

We are seeking an experienced
**Head of Quality**
to lead our Quality organization and drive world-class performance across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing the Quality Management System, developing quality strategies, leading customer and supplier quality initiatives, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and maintain the Quality Management System in compliance with IATF 16949 requirements.
* Develop and execute quality objectives, metrics, and improvement initiatives aligned with business goals.
* Manage customer and supplier quality activities, including audits, APQP, PPAP, launch readiness, corrective actions, and change management.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for internal and external quality issues.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor and report key quality metrics, including scrap, rework, and overall quality performance.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support production, new product launches, and supplier development.
* Build, develop, and lead high-performing quality teams.

**Success Competencies**

*The Head of Quality embodies the following competencies:*

* **Manages Complexity:**
  Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Decision Quality:**
  Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
* **Action Oriented:**
  Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm.
* **Ensures Accountability:**
  Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Drive Results:**
  Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* **Develops Talent:**
  Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals.
* **Builds Effective Teams:**
  Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspective to achieve common goals.
* **Communicates Effectively:**
  Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* **Instills Trust:**
  Gaining the confidence and trust of others though honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* **Manages Ambiguity:**
  Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
* **Being Resilient:**
  Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

Directly manages the Quality Department including the Quality Engineering, Quality Systems, Quality Planning, Quality Lab/ Gauging, Change and Series Management functions.

**Your Profile**

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* **Education:**
  A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical field is required, experience in Quality functions within the automotive industry or related areas.
* **Language:**
  Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, OEMs, or employees of organization.
* **Technology:**
  Microsoft Office Suite knowledge; SAP/ERP knowledge preferred. Knowledge of IATF 16949, APQP-PPAP, FMEA, MSA, 8D, Statistics, GD&T and mechanical manufacturing processes.
* **Travel:**
  Occasional travel, up to 10% including international

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. records.title: Vice President, Global GMP Quality
records.description:
**MISSION**

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The VP, Global GMP Quality position will be responsible for leading the GMP quality functional teams at Mirum and its subsidiaries (US and International). This position will play a pivotal role in steering the organization toward an ongoing commitment to quality improvement, driving efforts to identify areas for optimization, innovation, and excellence. This person will be responsible for managing, mentoring and supporting a GMP Operations team of clinical and commercial Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) professionals. This person will provide leadership and hands-on support to ensure the seamless execution of GMP QA and QC functions, including product quality complaint investigation, root-cause investigations, and the reporting of critical GMP issues to executive management.  This person will also be responsible for leading, providing direction, resources, and guidance to ensure that all GMP quality processes are executed with the highest standards of compliance with FDA, EMA, and other international regulatory requirements, corporate objectives, and industry best practices. This role also involves ensuring that the GMP and GDP quality functions are closely aligned with the organization’s broader strategic goals, guaranteeing that quality initiatives support the company’s mission, vision, and operational objectives.

**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader to assist the head of quality to further develop the quality culture at Mirum to be compliant, collaborative and phase appropriate.
* Develop and execute a global GMP quality strategy to align with corporate goals and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader within the Quality group to lead the GMP QA and QC functional teams in fostering professional development and guiding staff in all aspects of GMP/GDP competence in meeting domestic and international regulatory requirements and guidelines (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, ICH, etc.).
* Lead the development and optimization of key processes, functional collaboration, transformational initiatives, and operational excellence through the GMP/GDP Quality Unit.
* Serve as the GMP quality lead in Audits and Regulatory Inspections in providing strategic leadership, interactions, responses, CAPA plans and implementation.
* Lead the GMP inspection readiness for the Company including GMP Quality improvement and maintenance.
* Host/Manage GMP PAI/PLI inspections at Mirum and support Mirum PAI/PLI related CMO inspections.
* Drive corporate values, vision, goals, and objectives through collaboration with senior leaders building cross-functional networks to influence operational capabilities.
* Serve as a GMP Quality advisor to cross-functional stakeholders within Mirum global organizations and subsidiaries.
* Promote collaboration across internal and external functional teams and stakeholders to identify, design and implement opportunities for improvement across all areas of GMP and GDP quality responsibilities.
* Establish, maintain, and ensure effectiveness of GMP and GDP quality programs and documentation to assure GxP compliance in the domestic and international regulatory environment.
* Oversee, support and perform all aspects of GMP QA and QC activities and functions for drug manufacturing to ensure product quality and supply chain integrity.
* Oversee and support all aspects of clinical and commercial product release which includes direct to market, partner and distributor.
* Serve as the Material Review Board (MRB) chair-person designee.
* Develop and execute a global recall strategy that integrates domestic and international recalls.
* Serve as the Recall Coordinator in the recall committee and support the recall/mock recall process.
* Collaborate with Commercial Organization on launch strategies, NPP/EAP/CUP programs and provide input as a Quality SME.
* Review and approval of GMP, GDP, Partner and Distributor Quality/Technical Agreements.
* Oversee the review and approval of APQR generation in a timely fashion.
* Assess the outcome of GMP audits at CMOs, CTLs, Partners, etc. for a holistic view and to partner with the Technical Operations team in driving improvements.
* Provide strategic and managerial leadership related to company objectives & initiatives and changing regulatory requirements to build, manage, and mentor high-performance QA and QC teams in a global environment.
* Oversee product launch, manufacturing, and distribution quality processes.
* Lead a culture of quality excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Ensure global GMP Quality Team meets stakeholder needs, focusing on efficiency, quality, budget management, and corporate growth.
* Serve as Quality Head designee for other GXP areas beyond GMP and GDP as required.
* Requires 15% domestic and international travel, at minimum.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education /Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, biology, or other science related field (Advanced degree preferred).
* 15+ years of progressive Quality Assurance experience in pharmaceutical and/or Biotech industries, with at least 10+ years in quality leadership role and/or people management including direct & indirect reports.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of cGMP manufacturing and Quality Management in compliance with FDA (CBER and/or CDER) and EMA requirements for global-regulated products.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of the development and commercialization of medical device in compliance with FDA 21CFR820, ISO13485 and EMA MDR regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO, ICH, and global regulatory requirements.
* Product lifecycle including Late-stage drug development, Regulatory (NDA, MAA, BLA, etc) submission and commercial manufacturing experience.
* Experience with hosting and preparing for inspection readiness and an ability to provide recommendations for its continuous improvement.
* Must be able to work cross functionally as a strong collaborator with ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders across multiple global regions.
* Experience with managing Product Quality Complaints and Pharmacovigilance Quality is a plus
* Experience in rare disease and/or biologics, a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Extensive hands-on experience in product lifecycle management including late-phase innovative drug development, medical device, combination product and global commercial launch with global CMC regulatory filings (IND/IMPD/CTA/NDA/BLA/MAA, etc.) in a multinational pharmaceutical organization.
* Demonstrate project and cross-functional team leadership, as well as people management skills across different cultures.
* Thorough understanding and working experience in innovative drug development and manufacturing of drugs and biologics concerning GMP operations, quality systems, ICH guidelines, FDA, EMA, and associated international regulatory requirements.
* Extensive working experience with management and oversight of the analytical activities at CDMOs or CTLs with quality mind-set and leadership.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with strategic and sound technically driven decision-making ability.
* Highly effective and strong ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.
* Strong sense of ethics and honesty.
* Ability to communicate with all levels of management and peers within the organization.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills.

The salary range for this position is $320,000 to $340,000 USD. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to; skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location. Please note that the required compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits unless otherwise provided.

records.title: VP Quality, Compliance and Facilities
records.description:
At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
  
  
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or a related field.
* A minimum of 10–15 years (or more) of relevant experience in quality, compliance, and/or operations leadership in a high-volume manufacturing environment (Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, Automotive, or secure/payment products) , with at least 5-10 years experience in managing teams across multiple shift in a 24/7 environment :
* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience
* Very strong analytical skill set, including familiarity with quality and reliability tools (e.g., FMEA, SPC, Kaizen).
* Regulatory fluency:
* OSHA, EPA, ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety)
* Industrial hygiene and risk assessment methodologies
* Environmental compliance (emissions, waste management, hazmat handling)
* Process safety management
* Incident investigation and workers' compensation/claims oversight
* Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams required.
* Demonstrated experience in third party audits ( ISO , PCI, ....)
* Occasional travel to suppliers and partners.

**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**

* Quality certifications such as Black belt Six Sigma
* GHG Management
* Familiarity with ERP tools
* Experience in a secure payment, or otherwise highly regulated manufacturing environment.

**About CompoSecure**
CompoSecure, a GPGI business (NYSE: GPGI), is the leading manufacturer of Premium Metal Payment Cards and also offers best-in-class Authentication and Digital Asset solutions. The Company's offerings combine elegance, simplicity, and security to deliver exceptional experiences and peace of mind, enabling trust for millions of people around the globe. For more information, please visit
**www.CompoSecure.com**
and
**www.GetArculus.com**
.
  
  
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage; FSA/HSA options; company-paid life and disability insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off (PTO) and holidays; annual bonus opportunities; an employee assistance program (EAP); and opportunities for career growth and advancement.
  
  
*Additional details will be provided during the hiring process.*
CompoSecure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. We are also an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
  
  
**Please note:**
CompoSecure does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited resumes sent to CompoSecure, including to our employees, will become the property of CompoSecure and may be used without any obligation to pay referral or placement fees. Any agency or recruiter seeking to work with CompoSecure's Talent Acquisition Team should contact our team directly by sending an email to
**recruiting@composecure.com**
.
  
  
CompoSecure offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to work alongside a team of dedicated professionals who are shaping the future of financial technology.
  
  
**Pay Range**
**Incentive Compensation**
Offers will be negotiated based on each candidate's qualifications.
  
  
This role may be eligible to participate in our annual or quarterly incentive plan. Incentives are earned based on employee performance against defined metrics and company goals.
  
  
**Benefits**
Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program which includes Group Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Account, Group Term Life Insurance, and 401(k) retirement plan. You will be eligible to participate in benefits on the first day of the month after your hire date.
  
  
CompoSecure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

records.title: VP, Quality & Regulatory
records.description:
**The Krusteaz Company**
is looking for a
**Vice President of Quality & Regulatory**
! The VP, Quality & Regulatory is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the organization's enterprise-wide quality, regulatory affairs, and compliance programs. As the organization's primary authority on quality systems, regulatory strategy, and compliance integrity, they ensure that all operations meet or exceed applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal policies.
  
  
**Essential Functions:**
Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time.
  
  

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve an enterprise-wide Quality Management System aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Establish quality standards, policies, and procedures that drive consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across all business units and functions.
* Champion a culture of quality throughout the organization through visible leadership, targeted training programs, and clear performance accountability frameworks.
* Oversee internal audit programs, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, root cause analysis, and management review activities to identify, address and prevent recurrence of quality issues while driving measurable, systematic improvement.
* Serve as the organization's primary liaison with regulatory agencies (e.g., FDA, State Agencies and industry-specific authorities), accreditation organizations, and industry trade associations, cultivating credible relationships and maintaining organizational awareness of evolving regulatory and industry expectations.
* Monitor, interpret, and proactively communicate evolving regulatory requirements and their organizational impact to senior leadership and operational teams. Ensure all regulatory registrations, licenses, certifications, and required filings, ensuring timely renewal and full compliance.
* Design and oversee a comprehensive, risk-based enterprise compliance program encompassing regulatory, legal, and ethical compliance obligations across all operational areas.
* Ensure organizational adherence to applicable federal and state laws, regulations, standards, and internal policies through effective program design, monitoring, and enforcement mechanisms.
* Lead company’s Sustainability initiatives to ensure effectiveness and compliance for certifications, reporting, Extended Producer Responsibility, and Social Accountability programs. Provide guidance to Senior Leadership on risks, trends, or emergent issues and support implementation of improvements.
* Align the quality, regulatory, and compliance strategy with overall organizational objectives, ensuring that QRC is positioned as a strategic enabler rather than a compliance overhead.

**Position Requirements:**
*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals qualified with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Strong executive presence and business acumen and demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and tactically across the enterprise.
* Ability to translate complex regulatory and compliance landscapes into clear, actionable organizational strategies.
* Ability to recruit, build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance team capable of supporting current and future organizational needs.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-accountability team culture where expertise is valued, professional growth is supported, and performance standards are clear.
* Cultivate strong cross-functional partnerships across the business to embed quality and compliance into day-to-day operations.
* Serve as a contributing member of the senior leadership team, actively participating in strategic planning, enterprise risk management, and organizational governance.
* Advise Senior Leadership on regulatory and compliance risks, emerging issues, and strategic opportunities presented by the evolving regulatory landscape.
* Represent the organization externally at industry forums, regulatory proceedings, accreditation reviews, and with key external stakeholders.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems
  
  
**Education and/or Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Food Science or related degree; or equivalent experience/training.
* Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive, substantive experience in quality management, regulatory affairs, and/or compliance within a regulated industry.
* Minimum 7 years of demonstrated senior leadership experience managing cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams in a complex organizational environment.
* Proven track record of building, scaling, and continuously improving quality and compliance programs in organizations of meaningful size and complexity.
* Documented experience managing regulatory agency relationships, leading inspection readiness programs, and representing the organization during regulatory inspections and agency meetings.
* Experience operating in a multi-site, multi-jurisdictional, or global organizational environment with oversight of geographically distributed teams.
* Direct experience leading quality and regulatory due diligence activities in the context of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or significant partnership transactions.

**Get to know us:**
Learn more about our Corporate Office and Culture.
  
  
**Hybrid Work Model:**
At The Krusteaz Company, we have in-office "core days" of Tuesdays and Wednesdays where all corporate employees are expected to be onsite. Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays are flexible remote days to allow for work/life balance. You may be asked to come in outside of a core day from time to time, based on business needs. We have found aligning our scheduled in-office days provides an opportunity for employees to build connections and collaborate together.
  
  
**Benefits:**
We are proud to offer generous benefits including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (starting at $105/month for employee-only coverage on the PPO Plan or starting at $45/month for employee-only coverage on the HDHP), 401(K) matching, 4 weeks of paid vacation, 10 paid holidays, 1 paid personal holiday, company-provided life insurance and disability insurance, flexible spending account, healthcare savings account, voluntary accident insurance, voluntary critical illness insurance, and tuition reimbursement. Learn more about our Benefits.
  
  
**Salary Information:**
An employee in this position based out of Washington State can expect a salary range between $218,900 and $349,534. We typically pay out between $240,000 and $300,000. The actual salary offered will be carefully considered based on a wide range of factors, including internal equity, experience, education, certification, training, and location. All positions are eligible for additional incentives based on business performance.
  
  
**Physical Demands & Work Environment:**
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone along with reaching. Specific vision abilities include close vision requirements due to computer work. Moderate noise, ability to work in a confined area, and ability to sit at a computer for an extended period of time are also included.

records.description:
Vaco has partnered with Ypsomed USA during a pivotal stage of its North American expansion to identify a
**Head of Quality/QA**
who will play a key leadership role in building and scaling the U.S. organization.
  
  

**Head of Quality/QA USA**

Ypsomed is a leading Swiss medical technology company specializing in the development, manufacture, and supply of innovative injection systems for self-medication. With our solutions, we enable people worldwide to administer their medication safely, conveniently, and independently.

As Head of QA USA, you will play a key role in establishing and leading the Quality organization at our US location. You will build a strong quality culture, ensure regulatory compliance and manufacturing readiness, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to enable the safe, reliable, and sustainable supply of our products. In this leadership role, you will shape the quality strategy from the ground up and contribute directly to the successful growth of our site.

**Your Main Tasks:**

* Define and implement the Quality strategy and organization for the US site in close alignment with corporate functions, ensuring manufacturing readiness from the outset.
* Build, lead, and continuously develop a high-performing local Quality team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure the site Quality Management System is established, maintained, and continuously improved in compliance with corporate standards, FDA requirements, ISO 13485, MDSAP, Pharma GMP, and relevant combination product expectations.
* Provide senior Quality leadership for complex site-level issues, ensuring sound risk assessment, effective escalation, and timely decision-making.
* Oversee core Quality processes including nonconformance management, CAPA, change control, risk management, process validation, and internal/external audits.
* Ensure strong Quality oversight across industrialization, incoming materials, manufacturing, release-related activities, and ongoing operations to support compliant and efficient product supply.
* Partner closely with Corporate Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to embed Quality requirements into transfers, implementation activities, and operational readiness.
* Act as the primary US Quality contact for audits, inspections, and external assessments, while driving inspection readiness and continuous improvement of local processes, systems, tools, and templates.

* University degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical/Medical Engineering, Pharmacy, Quality Management, or a related field; alternatively, a technical background with additional quality management certification.
* 10+ years of progressive Quality experience, including leadership responsibility, within medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or combination products in regulated manufacturing environments.
* Deep expertise in Quality Management Systems and applicable regulations, including FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, MDSAP, Pharma GMP, and combination product requirements.

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
  Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
  Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**
  Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
* **Quality Systems & Digital Traceability:**
  Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
* **Enterprise Leadership:**

  Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.

**What Sets You Apart**

You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

records.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

  

The Global Head of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of ProSciento's global Quality department, establishing the strategy, direction, governance, and priorities for the function. This role will oversee the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensures the organization maintains the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and inspection readiness.

  

This role is accountable for establishing and advancing the company's quality strategy, Quality by Design and governance framework, and quality culture while ensuring compliance with applicable GxP regulations, FDA requirements, ISO standards, and other country specific, regional, and international regulatory requirements. The Global Head of Quality partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, risk management, and organizational effectiveness while supporting ProSciento's strategic growth. Performs duties in accordance with ProSciento's values, policies, and procedures. Approximately 20% domestic and international travel is expected, with additional travel required based on business needs.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

  
* Provides strategic leadership for ProSciento’s Quality department, establishing the vision, priorities, and organizational structure to support the company’s operations and business objectives.
  
* Accountable for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations including GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), FDA, ISO, data privacy requirements, and other local, national, and international requirements.
  
* Responsible to oversee the quality of Global CRO studies and local site CRU trials as well as hands on experience implementing and maintaining a strategic Quality by Design framework for both business units.
  
* Responsible for the definition, development, implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of quality systems, processes, and Key Quality indicators (KQIs) to drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  

  

  
* Oversees the Quality Event Management program, including deviations, CAPAs, change control, investigations, risk assessments, and process improvement initiatives. Chairs or delegates the CAPA Board and ensures timely resolution of quality issues.
  
* Directs internal, external, sponsor, vendor, and regulatory inspection readiness activities, including audit planning, execution, response management, and corrective action oversight.
  
* Partners with Vendor Management to oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits, performance monitoring, and quality risk mitigation.
  
* Leads Executive Quality Management Reviews, ensuring quality trends, compliance risks, audit outcomes, CAPAs, and quality metrics are routinely communicated to Executive Leadership with appropriate recommendations and mitigation strategies.
  
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and governance of Quality Management System documentation, including quality policies, SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training programs, equipment records, and electronic document management systems.
  
* Partners with Information Technology and business leaders to ensure computerized systems, electronic records, and applicable equipment are appropriately qualified, verified, or validated in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  
* Establishes and promotes a culture of quality throughout the organization by providing strategic guidance, regulatory interpretation, and quality leadership across all functional departments.
  
* Maintains current knowledge of evolving global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices, ensuring organizational policies and procedures remain compliant and effective.
  
* Builds, develops, and leads a high-performing Quality organization by fostering employee development, succession planning, collaboration, accountability, and a culture aligned with ProSciento's core values.
  
* Serves as the senior quality representative for regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, and executive leadership on matters relating to quality systems, compliance, and inspection readiness.
  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Provides leadership and oversight for the Quality organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, recruitment, employee development, performance management, succession planning, coaching, and employee engagement.
  
* Establishes departmental objectives, allocates resources, and ensures the Quality organization effectively supports ProSciento's strategic and operational priorities.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Qualifications:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the CRO or clinical research industry, including at least 5 years in senior quality leadership roles with responsibility for organizational quality strategy and personnel management with a minimum of 3 years of Global experience.
  
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

  

  
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems and quality governance, with demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality systems within clinical research and regulated environments.
  
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA regulations, ICH Guidelines, GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), ISO 9001, data integrity, and applicable privacy requirements. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) supporting GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP) environments and clinical research operations.
  
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor and internal audits, supplier qualification programs, CAPA governance, inspection readiness, and enterprise quality risk management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing quality organizations, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
* Proven strategic leadership, organizational planning, and change management skills, with the ability to partner with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish quality strategies and organizational priorities.
  
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.
  
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  
* Experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor interactions, and quality governance forums.
  
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  
* Proficiency with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, quality metrics, and computerized system validation principles.
  

  

**Language Skills:**

  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to interpret complex regulations, prepare executive reports, develop policies and procedures, and effectively communicate with regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, executive leadership, and employees.

  

**Reasoning Skills:**

  

Ability to analyze complex regulatory and operational issues, exercise sound judgment, assess organizational risk, and develop practical, compliant solutions in a dynamic business environment.

  

**Computer Skills:**

  

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, learning management systems, audit management tools, and computerized system validation principles. Ability to quickly learn new software applications.

  

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

  

Verification of educational requirements, employment history, professional references, and certifications/training and U.S. work authorization.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL EFFORT**

The above job description does not imply these outlined duties are the only duties performed by this employee. The incumbent is expected to perform other related duties necessary for the effective operation of the department and company.

  

ProSciento reserves the right to change or alter any of the above duties and responsibilities according to the operational needs of the department and company.

records.title: VP, Inventory Control & Quality Assurance
records.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
  
  
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
  
  
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
  
  
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
  
  
**About The Role**
Stord is looking for a Vice President of Quality to build and lead the quality function across our fulfillment network.
  
  
This leader will own the systems, standards, and operating mechanisms that ensure inventory is accurate, processes are followed, and every order moves through our network the way it was designed to. The mandate spans the full lifecycle of inventory inside our buildings from inbound receipt and putaway through picking, packing, sorting, and outbound shipment.
  
  
This is an independent quality function. While our Operations teams are responsible for delivering volume efficiently, the VP of Quality is responsible for ensuring we never achieve speed, growth, or cost improvements by compromising inventory integrity or execution quality.
  
  
This leader should be an inventory and fulfillment quality expert at heart — someone who understands how inventory moves through a complex fulfillment operation, knows where process breakdowns create downstream failures, and is relentless about identifying and eliminating root causes.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Inventory Health & Accuracy**

* Own inventory health and accuracy across Stord's fulfillment network.
* Establish the standards, controls, and operating mechanisms required to maintain book-to-floor and floor-to-book inventory integrity.
* Own cycle counting, inventory reconciliation, adjustment governance, and inventory variance reduction.
* Build mechanisms to identify inventory defects early and systematically eliminate their root causes.
* Establish network-level metrics and reporting that make inventory health visible and actionable.

**Fulfillment Process Quality**

* Own process adherence across inbound, receiving, putaway, picking, packing, sorting, and outbound operations.
* Define the critical quality controls for each process path and ensure sites consistently execute against them.
* Build audit mechanisms that identify process drift before it becomes a customer or inventory issue.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data to eliminate systemic sources of defects.
* Develop a clear view of transaction volume, exception rates, and defect rates by process path to identify where quality is breaking down.

**Lot Control & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own lot, expiration-date, and inventory-attribute accuracy across applicable customers and facilities.
* Establish controls for FIFO, FEFO, lot traceability, recalls, quarantine, and other regulated inventory requirements.
* Ensure Stord's operating processes meet applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual quality requirements.
* Build a quality organization capable of supporting increasingly complex and regulated categories as Stord grows.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Build a rigorous root-cause and corrective-action discipline across the fulfillment network.
* Turn recurring defects into permanent process, system, or training improvements rather than repeatedly solving individual incidents.
* Identify network-wide trends and deploy standardized improvements across sites.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure recurring operational defects inform the technology roadmap.
* Create a culture where defects are surfaced quickly, investigated objectively, and permanently resolved.

**Quality Organization**

* Build and lead Stord's network Quality and Inventory Control organization.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability between Quality and Operations.
* Develop site and regional quality leaders capable of independently auditing operational performance.
* Serve as the executive escalation point when inventory integrity, regulatory compliance, or fulfillment quality is at risk.
* Maintain an independent point of view and be willing to stop, challenge, or redesign processes when quality standards are not being met.

**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for someone who has spent their career inside
**large, complex fulfillment or distribution operations**
and understands inventory at a level most operators do not.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate**

* Has 12+ years of experience across fulfillment quality, inventory control, operational excellence, distribution, or supply chain operations, including significant leadership experience.
* Has led quality or inventory control across a multi-site fulfillment or distribution network.
* Comes from a scaled 3PL, retailer, e-commerce fulfillment network, food distribution company, or similarly complex physical operation.
* Is deeply fluent in inventory control, WMS-driven processes, cycle counting, reconciliation, lot control, and inventory accuracy.
* Understands the mechanics of inbound, putaway, pick, pack, sort, and outbound processes — and how defects in one process create downstream failures elsewhere.
* Has built quality systems based on data, audits, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and measurable defect reduction.
* Is comfortable challenging Operations leadership when execution does not meet the required standard.
* Has operated in environments where quality and compliance cannot be traded for throughput or cost.
* Ideally brings experience from food, grocery, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another environment with rigorous lot, expiration, traceability, or regulatory requirements.
* Can operate strategically at the executive level while still being willing to go onto the warehouse floor, trace an inventory discrepancy through a WMS, and understand exactly where a process failed.

Votaw Precision Technologies is a trusted leader in the manufacturing of complex precision components, assemblies, and systems for the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors. With a strong reputation for technical excellence, quality craftsmanship, and on-time delivery, Votaw supports some of the world’s most demanding programs through its advanced manufacturing capabilities. The ideal candidate is a seasoned machining professional with approximately 20 years of industry experience who understands metal cutting and CNC machining at a deep technical level and has progressed into a strong operational leadership role.

The Operations Director must be able to walk onto the shop floor, understand the machining challenges, evaluate processes, communicate effectively with machinists and programmers, identify inefficiencies, and make sound technical and operational decisions. The company utilizes a variety of CNC machining technologies, including 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis machining, as well as vertical milling, welding and large-scale assembly tooling.

**Essential Functions**

* Responsible for ensuring that the entire organization operates safely, efficiently, profitably, and to the highest standards of quality and technical excellence.
* Have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the CNC machine shop.
* Establish and maintain a culture of technical excellence, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Provide leadership and direction to machining, programming, production, quality, maintenance, and other shop personnel.
* Ensure the shop has the appropriate personnel, equipment, tooling, processes, and resources to meet customer requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for supervisors, leads, machinists, programmers, and support personnel.
* Serve as the primary operational leader and decision maker for the manufacturing facility.
* Work closely with programmers, machinists, and engineers to resolve technical machining issues.
* Evaluate machining processes and identify opportunities to improve cycle time, tool life, throughput, and quality.
* Ensure manufacturing processes are technically sound, repeatable, and scalable.
* Provide technical guidance when difficult or complex machining problems arise.
* Maintain an environment where machinists, engineers, programmers continuously improve their technical capabilities.

records.description:
**Spartronics, LLC**

**Career Opportunity: Site Director of Operations**

**Location:**
North Logan, Utah

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | Salaried | Exempt

**Work Arrangement:**
On-Site

**Schedule:**
Full-Time, Monday–Friday

**Reports To:**
Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader

**Who We Are**

At
**Spartronics**
, we build more than electronics. We build the technology that powers critical applications across aerospace and defense, medical devices, life sciences, and industrial markets.

As a leading provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS), Spartronics specializes in complex, high-reliability products, including printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), electromechanical assemblies, integrated systems, and complete product manufacturing solutions.

**Career Opportunity: Director of Operations**

Spartronics is seeking an experienced
**Director of Operations**
to lead manufacturing operations and drive operational excellence at our North Logan, Utah facility.

This senior leadership position is responsible for the overall performance, execution, and continuous improvement of the site's operational functions, including Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning, while providing indirect operational oversight and cross-functional partnership with Program Management.

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader, the Director of Operations will establish operational priorities, develop high-performing teams, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure the organization consistently achieves its safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability objectives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong business acumen, experience managing multiple operational disciplines, and a proven ability to drive results in complex, highly regulated manufacturing environments.

**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for the facility, translating organizational objectives into actionable plans, performance expectations, and measurable results.
* Direct Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning functions, ensuring effective coordination, accountability, and alignment with site and corporate objectives.
* Provide indirect operational oversight and strategic partnership to Program Management, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, program execution, operational capacity and business objectives.
* Direct manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, and resource allocation, balancing changing customer demand, product complexity, and manufacturing constraints to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Establish operational priorities, evaluate performance against key metrics, and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps and emerging risks.
* Provide leadership and oversight of engineering activities, including process optimization, technical problem resolution, manufacturing readiness, new product introduction, and product transfers.
* Ensure the effectiveness of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, and corrective and preventive action processes while preserving Quality's independent authority over product acceptance and compliance decisions.
* Oversee supply chain and materials planning activities, including procurement, supplier performance, inventory management, material availability, and production support.
* Partner with Program Management and other customer-facing functions to address delivery commitments, operational concerns, customer escalations, and changing business requirements.
* Develop operational budgets, resource plans, capital expenditure priorities, and cost improvement initiatives in collaboration with Finance, supporting achievement of site financial objectives and profitability targets..
* Evaluate operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability, reduce waste, control costs, and optimize resource utilization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure manufacturing processes, product traceability, configuration and change control, and supporting documentation comply with applicable customer, industry, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure operational compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Establish and maintain structured operational performance management systems, including KPI reviews, cross-functional accountability, issue escalation, and corrective action follow-through to support timely, data-driven decision-making.
* Build, coach, and develop operational leadership teams, establishing clear performance expectations, succession plans, and workforce competency and development priorities.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing requirements, employee performance, organizational development, and retention strategies.
* Coordinate with Facilities, Security, and other support functions to address infrastructure needs, operational continuity, physical security requirements, and business risks.
* Evaluate manufacturing capacity, technology, equipment, and infrastructure needs to support business growth, operational scalability, and capital investment decisions.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with production disruptions, supplier constraints, quality concerns, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Represent site operations in corporate leadership discussions, customer interactions, audits, and strategic planning activities, communicating performance, priorities, and resource requirements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity overseeing multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations with accountability for production, engineering, quality, supply chain, and cross-functional business objectives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, materials management, and operational performance improvement.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing engineering principles, process controls, technical problem resolution, and new product introduction activities.
* Working knowledge of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, corrective action processes, and applicable manufacturing standards.
* Proven ability to develop and execute operational strategies, establish performance objectives, and achieve measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience utilizing financial metrics, cost management practices, capital planning processes, and profitability analysis to drive operational decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable cross-functional management teams while promoting collaboration and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience applying Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methodologies to complex operational challenges.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate competing priorities, manage operational risks, and resolve complex business issues.
* Advanced proficiency with business and manufacturing information systems, including ERP/MRP platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and data analysis and reporting tools. Demonstrated ability to interpret operational and financial data, evaluate performance trends, and leverage technology to support strategic planning and informed decision-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, senior leadership, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage sensitive business information, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality in accordance with company and applicable security requirements.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and comprehend English sufficiently to interpret technical documentation, communicate operational requirements, and perform essential job responsibilities.
* Ability to work full-time on-site at the assigned company facility in Logan, UT.

**Security Clearance Requirement**

Candidates must possess current, verifiable eligibility for a U.S. Government Secret-level security clearance or be willing and able to complete the necessary documentation to initiate the company-sponsored clearance process within 60 days of hire. The ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearance eligibility is a continuing condition of employment. Employment may continue while an appropriately initiated clearance application is pending, subject to company authorization and applicable security restrictions. A final determination of ineligibility, denial, or loss of required clearance eligibility will result in disqualification from the position and may result in termination of employment, subject to applicable law and company policy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Leadership experience within electronics manufacturing services (EMS), printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), or high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environments.
* Experience with surface mount technology (SMT), through-hole assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing test, and related electronics manufacturing processes.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable IPC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Knowledge of ITAR, controlled technical information, and security requirements applicable to defense-related manufacturing.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or other recognized continuous improvement credentials.
* APICS/ASCM certification, such as CPIM or CSCP, or equivalent supply chain management credentials.
* Experience leading operational transformations, facility expansions, production transfers, or significant manufacturing improvement initiatives.
* Experience utilizing business intelligence platforms, advanced reporting tools, and integrated manufacturing systems to monitor operational performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships, operational escalations, and cross-functional business challenges.

**Key Metrics and Focus Areas**

* Workplace safety performance and regulatory compliance.
* On-time delivery performance and production schedule attainment.
* Manufacturing efficiency, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Product quality, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Inventory accuracy, material availability, and inventory turns.
* Supplier delivery, quality, and overall performance.
* Operating cost performance, budget adherence, and profitability.
* Engineering responsiveness, manufacturing readiness, and successful new product introductions.
* Program execution support and fulfillment of customer commitments.
* Continuous improvement results, waste reduction, and operational efficiency.
* Quality management system effectiveness, audit performance, and corrective action closure.
* Workforce productivity, employee development, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Operational risk management, business continuity, and capacity readiness.

**Why This Role Matters**

As
**Director of Operations,**
you will play a critical role in shaping the performance, operational capabilities, and continued growth of our North Logan manufacturing facility. Your leadership will directly influence how effectively we deliver complex, high-reliability electronic products to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding industries. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams, strengthen operational performance, implement meaningful improvements, and contribute to the long-term success of a growing manufacturing organization.

**Benefits – Why Join Spartronics?**

At Spartronics, we recognize that our employees are essential to our success. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and professional development of our team members.

Benefits may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off and company-paid holidays.
* Company-paid life insurance and disability benefits.
* Employee assistance and wellness resources.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative products supporting mission-critical industries.

*Specific benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan documents and company policies.*

**Physical Requirements and Work Location**

* Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments, including regular movement throughout production, warehouse, and operational areas.
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, with occasional bending and reaching.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to operate computers and standard office equipment.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when entering designated manufacturing areas.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Work Authorization & ITAR Requirements**

Due to the nature of certain products, technologies, and customer requirements, this position may involve access to export-controlled technical data or defense-related information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and other applicable export control laws. Candidates must meet applicable U.S. export control authorization requirements and be eligible to access controlled technical information as required by the position. For this position, additional U.S. Government security clearance eligibility requirements apply, as described above.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Spartronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled 41 CFR 60-1.4. We comply with federal Affirmative Action guidelines in all employment opportunities for qualified employees and applicants.Employment at Spartronics is considered at-will, meaning that either the employee or Spartronics may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without prior notification.*

**Description**
**THE COMPANY**
For over 40 years, Aero Simulation, Inc. (ASI) has provided quality flight training devices to the US Military. ASI has successfully built numerous training systems with a primary focus on aircrew and maintenance training systems. Our current programs include, but are not limited to, the B-1 Training Systems (Air Force), E-2D Training Systems (Navy), CH-53E Training Devices (USMC), IMOMS (Coast Guard), Navigation, Seamanship, Shiphandling Trainer – NSST (Navy). To learn more about ASI visit Programs- Aero Simulation, Inc.
  
  
ASI is a 100% employee-owned engineering and manufacturing company committed to supporting the nation’s warfighters. Being 100% employee-owned directly impacts our culture: it drives our decision-making, motivates our teams, increases our productivity, improves retention and contributes to the future success of our company. Our culture is one where we work hard for our clients and for each other – and we have fun collaborating, sharing experience and expertise, and learning along the way. We strive to deliver exceptional quality, elevate client relationships, and enrich the careers and lives of our employee-owners. As Employee-Owners, we are invested in the success and continued development of each other and the company.
  
  
In addition to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), we offer a flexible work environment, generous paid time off, professional development opportunities, industry competitive compensation, and superior benefits to include medical, dental, 401k and more!
  
  
ASI is a great place to build a career and grow with a company that is dedicated to quality, service and to fostering a community of support for each and every member of the team. To learn more about this opportunity, keep reading!
  
  
**Position Summary**
ASI is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Production to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight of its production organization. This is a key senior leadership position responsible for ensuring the successful manufacturing, assembly, integration, and delivery of ASI's advanced simulation and military training device hardware.
  
  
Based in Tampa, Florida, and reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), the Director of Production will oversee Production Control, Material Control, and Manufacturing through functional managers and department leads. The position will also provide executive oversight of Facility Management and Workplace Safety through the Facilities Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations, developing high-performing teams, managing production capacity and resources, and delivering technical products in demanding, schedule-driven environments.
  
  
This individual will play an important role in supporting ASI's Department of Defense, U.S. military, government agency, and defense industry programs while ensuring the organization is positioned to support new business opportunities and long-term growth.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
*Strategic Leadership & Operational Management*

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for Production Control, Material Control, and Manufacturing.
* Establish production priorities, performance expectations, resource requirements, and organizational objectives.
* Lead through functional managers, promoting accountability, operational discipline, and effective execution.
* Ensure production operations consistently meet contractual commitments, customer requirements, program milestones, and delivery schedules.
* Partner with executive leadership to develop operational strategies supporting current programs and future business growth.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure organizational effectiveness and drive improvement.

*Production Planning & Program Execution*

* Oversee production planning, scheduling, capacity management, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent programs.
